memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Do not have two differing weights in your bag—one heavy, one light. Do not have two differing measures in your house—one large, one small. You must have accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you. - Deut 25:13-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God commands honesty in business dealings. Merchants used weights and measures to buy and sell, and a dishonest trader might keep two sets, using a heavier weight when buying and a lighter one when selling, cheating people in the process. God forbids this. His people were to have accurate, honest weights and measures. Integrity was to mark every transaction.

This reveals that God cares about honesty not just in the temple, but in the marketplace, in the everyday details of commerce and dealings with others. Cheating someone through deceptive practices, even subtly, is a serious matter to God. He sees the hidden weights in the bag, the small dishonesties we might think no one notices. True faith shows itself in honest, fair dealings with everyone.

We should not read the promise of long life in the land as a guarantee of prosperity for honest people, but as reflecting God's design that integrity leads to a flourishing, stable community, while dishonesty corrodes it. The enduring principle is clear, God's people are to be scrupulously honest in all their dealings, in business, in work, in every exchange. The New Testament calls us to be honest in the sight of everyone and to put away all falsehood (Rom 12:17; Eph 4:25). Our honesty reflects the character of the God of truth. Where might God be calling you to greater integrity in your everyday dealings, even in small things others might not notice?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you scrupulously honest in all your dealings?
2. Where might small dishonesties be creeping in?
3. How does God's truthfulness shape your integrity?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You are the God of truth who sees every hidden thing. Make me honest and full of integrity in all my dealings, even the small ones. Amen.
